thread:
sara_support: Hey team — GreenLeaf (merchant) reported invoice INV-3241 failed at checkout. Customer says card had funds but payment declined. Frontend shows 3DS iframe never loads (spinning). Raising for triage, cc @mira_payments @devon_ops
mira_payments: Thanks. Can you share payment_attempt_id + last4? Also any gateway payloads you have.
greenleaf-cs: payment_attempt_id: pay_att_01GxQZXY, last4: 4242. I can repro locally: click pay -> quick flash -> blank iframe. No challenge UI.
devon_ops: Copying basic gateway trace — run: curl -sS "https://api.redwood.com/v1/payments/attempts/pay_att_01GxQZXY/logs" 
Returned snippets:

{"code":"issuer_decline","decline_code":"insufficient_funds","message":"Card declined by issuer"}
{"code":"risk_reject","risk_action":"reject","risk_reason":"velocity_and_high_risk_profile"}

Also note acquirer returned acs_url -> but client console shows blocked frame load.
aj_eng: Could be two things: issuer decline (insufficient funds) and separately a fraud reject rule firing. For the iframe: check response headers from ACS redirect — common culprit is SameSite cookie or CSP/frame-ancestors blocking.

Open devtools on a repro session and inspect network for the ACS URL redirect. If you see Set-Cookie SameSite=Strict or X-Frame-Options/CSP blocking, iframe will be empty.
mira_payments: Pasted gateway response (sanitized):

HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: https://acs.acquirer.example/challenge?session=abcd
Set-Cookie: acs_session=eyJ...; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict
Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' https://bank.example

So ACS sets SameSite=Strict and CSP frame-ancestors restricts to bank.example -> when our checkout is hosted on merchant domain the ACS cannot render inside our iframe.
devon_ops: That explains blank iframe. UX wise this looks like a failure to challenge -> fallback should attempt redirect flow or use hosted-pay to avoid iframe. For immediate mitigation: enable merchant-level fallback_acquirer for next 3 attempts and send hosted payment link.

Commands I ran (internal):

# enable fallback routing for merchant
POST /internal/admin/merchants/merch_773/override-routing {"fallback_acquirer":true,"ttl_minutes":30}

# create hosted-pay link
POST /v1/invoices/INV-3241/hosted_pay -> returns url https://pay.redwood.com/h/INV-3241/abc

mira_payments: Done — fallback routing enabled and hosted-pay link created. Sent to GreenLeaf: https://pay.redwood.com/h/INV-3241/abc

greenleaf-cs: I paid via the hosted link and it succeeded. Thank you :raised_hands:
aj_eng: For a durable fix we need fraud team to review the rule that rejects when low balance + high velocity; also discuss with Integrations to detect ACS SameSite/CSP and automatically switch to redirect flow.

mira_payments: Opening FR and firewall ticket: FR-1122 (auto-detect ACS frame-block + switch to redirect). Also creating fraud review case: FRD-540 (merchant-specific override request).

incidents-bot: Created ticket INC-7892 for merchant outage (priority P2) and assigned to payments-ops.
sara_support: Thanks everyone. Summary for ticket: two root causes — (1) issuer returned insufficient_funds (customer resolved via hosted link) and (2) ACS challenge blocked by SameSite/CSP causing blank iframe -> fallback to redirect needed. Follow-ups: fraud rule review + auto-detect redirect FR. I'll update merchant and close when FR/FRD tasks are triaged. :thumbsup:
